summary: Independent review found that the exact candidate restores the defined per-request spec_draft and spec_verify tracing contract on EAGLE V2, multi-layer EAGLE V2, and NGRAM. It records drafts-only num_correct_drafts and the accepted_tokens compatibility alias through the existing setter, while guarding the device-to-host acceptance-count read when global tracing is disabled. The intentionally removed spec_draft_extend stage remains absent.

tests.command: git grep -n -F set_spec_verify_start_time -- python; git grep -n -F set_spec_verify_end_time -- python; git grep -n -F set_spec_draft_start_time -- python/sglang/srt/speculative/eagle_worker_v2.py; git grep -n -F SPEC_DRAFT_EXTEND -- python
tests.what_was_measured: On the recorded base, the first two searches returned only setter definitions and the EAGLE/draft-extend searches returned no matches, reproducing the original missing-call-site failure. The aggregate shell block completed successfully while preserving individual empty search results in raw/base-source-reproduction.txt.

At exact candidate commit bd95273ff6988e1191c9d387783fd8ac15f8bcdb, 11 tests passed. They cover restored worker call sites, drafts-only count conversion, a shared timestamp, empty batches, and no device read/request mutation with tracing disabled.

Independent adversarial checks on the assigned gfx950 GPU verified accept_lens [1, 2, 5] maps to drafts-only counts [0, 1, 4], including the zero-draft boundary; disabled tracing did not call request setters; None/empty batches avoided tensor operations; and both EAGLE implementations use the shared verify closure.

tests.what_was_measured: All changed Python source and test files compiled, and the exact candidate diff had no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 executed the independent acceptance-count check on one AMD Instinct MI350X, reported capability (9, 5), i.e. gfx950. This was a focused tensor-path check, not model serving.

remaining_limitations: No EAGLE or NGRAM model weights were provided, so no live server or OpenTelemetry exporter trace was produced.
The GPU check validates the candidate's exact device-tensor conversion, not model semantic accuracy, a distinct model architecture, multi-GPU behavior, or multi-node behavior.
No native source changed and repository-environment.json declares no prepared native component, so no native rebuild was applicable.

The original issue asks maintainers to define the contract; the sole issue comment narrows it to spec_draft and spec_verify and explicitly treats spec_draft_extend as deliberately removed. The review follows that documented boundary.
